name: Chart
summary: Sized, named surface that hosts a Recharts chart wearing Aurea tokens.

a11y.apg: none: there is no APG pattern for a chart. The practice adopted is a named group around the drawing, because the <svg> the engine emits is role="application" and an application with no name around it tells the reader nothing about what it is reading. Keyboard navigation between data points is the engine's accessibility layer, on by default.
a11y.keyboardNote: NOT measured in a browser. The Chart wraps Recharts, whose keyboard belongs to the chart engine and needs a bank with real data plus a series in focus. Declared here as UNVERIFIED on purpose: check 30 requires this note precisely so that a keyboard written from memory cannot pass as measured. See G-A11Y-09.

props.name: children
props.description: REQUIRED. One Recharts chart element (AreaChart, BarChart, LineChart…). Aurea does not wrap the chart types: the engine draws, this component holds.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the whole drawing. Say what it plots, not that it is a chart.

props.name: className
props.description: Added to the box. The height is CSS, not a prop — a dimension comes from a class, so density still reaches it and nobody writes a raw pixel.
